Before the form, an echo. Indigo gathers these invisible tracesand transforms them into jewelry: five tales exploring matter, time and intimacy. An invitation to listen to the silence that still resonates within. [Rhythm] [Rhythm] [first] [TALE] Rhythm Freedom dancing beyond boundaries. Precious details for those who live by their own rules. NOMADIC- -RHYTHM NOMADIC- -RHYTHM I dwell in the freedom of movement, in its irregular cadence. I seek an aesthetic that vibrates through the body, sparking a dance without limits. Every rhythm is rebellion, every detail a living presence. SELENE RING Sterling Silver 925 Handcrafted, hand-forged Mirror-polished with burnished details Adjustable open ring Request info [STORY] This ring was born from the desire to embody a playful, surprising spirit. Its inspiration is the moon, the ultimate feminine symbol, long associated with life and nature from cycles and fertility to tides and harvests.
